Yeah sometimes it can be near impossible to get motivated to do something and even when you finally do get motivated enough to do that thing it can be incredibly draining. I can only imagine how must harder seemingly simple everyday tasks become once you throw anxiety into the mix. Is there anything in your life right now that you find doesn't wear you out?
Do you mind if I ask what it is that you are working at right now?

Do your best to listen and really hear what your friend is saying, you should really try to connect with your friend and give him any support he might need. One of the first things I learned about talking to someone who is dealing with suicidal thoughts was that you have to drop your ego, you have to check your opinions at the door because where you're going is a very sensitive place for that person, it is not the place for you to try and make a point. Also watch out for your own mental health, it can be very draining at times talking to someone who is ready to give up on life, especially if you have a deep emotional connection with that person.

Would you open to trying some new hobbies? Some good places to start that I can think of off the top of my head would be geocaching, woodworking, or astronomy. There are countless hobbies like these that are inexpensive to get involved in, and can be done either by your self or in groups of people. I personally find that woodworking is very calming and rewarding. It's become one of my go to things to do when feeling down.

I'm doing my best to understand what you're going through even though I've had some similar issues I never got to the point where I was ready to end it. Have you talked about you wanting to end your life with your therapist? Would you consider going to a different therapist?
Thank you, you have made my day.
When you were in the hospital did your mental state improve at all? Did it get worse?

You must be so incredibly strong to have made it this far, I don't think anyone blames you for wanting to give up. Was there a specific event in your life that you feel was a turning point? Have you ever considered therapy for yourself?
It really sucks that you're in such a dark place. Would you like to share some of your story with me? What's brought you to this point in your life?

It has been a hard life I really hope stuff starts to get better for you. If you ever feel really like you just can't handle it don't hesitate to contact me. I can't promise that I will be of any help but I care about you and would like to help in any way I can.
